subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable message-presentation multi-select contract in the shared message tool and Plugin SDK, or keep batch-selection in plugin/channel-specific surfaces?
rationale: The request crosses a public SDK/message-tool contract plus multiple channel render and callback paths, and the exact payload/fallback semantics are a maintainer product/API choice rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Add a portable contract
options.body: Define an additive shared multi-select presentation block with selected-values aggregation, channel limits, fallback text, docs, and channel adapter tests.

options.title: Keep it plugin-specific
options.body: Use before_agent_reply or channel-specific plugin surfaces for custom batch selection, leaving the shared message presentation contract single-select for now.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Decline core/SDK support and ask users to solve batch selection through external plugins or text replies, accepting inconsistent channel UX.

recommendation.title: Add a portable contract
recommendation.body: Define an additive shared multi-select presentation block with selected-values aggregation, channel limits, fallback text, docs, and channel adapter tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal for the shared presentation/SDK surface and already participated in the issue cleanup history.
